text:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock scope for private deploy work: VPC connectors, on-prem agent packaging, and a safe upgrade path. Customers are asking for in-place upgrades and customer-managed networking docs.
Miguel (Eng): For upgrades the biggest risk is stateful components + DB migrations. Suggest canary channel + image pinning.
Samir (SRE): +1. Also require a rollback plan and automated health checks that gate rollouts. Define SLIs for upgrade windows.
Lin (Solutions): Field asks: some customers want us to manage peering, others insist on customer-managed NAT/peering. We should offer both patterns with clear tradeoffs.
Julia (Support): Heads up — day-one support load will be heavy if upgrade UX is bumpy. We need runbooks, escalation matrix, and templated NetOps checklists.
Miguel (Eng): Implementation suggestion: v1 = OCI/tar artifacts + helm chart for k8s; v2 = operator that runs lifecycle (canary, rollbacks, migration hooks). That lets us ship sooner.
Anya (PM): Proposed launch criteria for v1: 1) e2e automated upgrade test passing, 2) rollback documented and tested (<5m restore), 3) runbook + customer checklist published, 4) 2 pilot customers onboarded.
Samir (SRE): Add: metrics/logs exported in a standard format (prom/k8s events) and KMS integration smoke test (even if we defer full-managed KMS).
Lin (Solutions): I can run pilots. Need a prescriptive network checklist to hand to customer NetOps: ports, CIDR, DNS, and sample iptables rules.
Miguel (Eng): Sample firewall snippet to include in docs:
```
# allow agent -> control-plane
tcp 443 10.0.0.0/8 -> controlplane.redwood.example.com
# allow node <-> node for KV sync
tcp 7000-7003 10.0.0.0/8
```
Anya (PM): Scope negotiation: proposal to drop self-hosted KMS and advanced RBAC in v1; include them in v2 roadmap. That buys time for stability. Any objections?
Miguel (Eng): Fine on KMS deferral, but call out encryption-at-rest baseline and customer-managed keys as a v2 must. Also optimize agent image size (<200MB target) for constrained customers.
Samir (SRE): For upgrade windows we should set a default maintenance window policy and make it configurable. Also require a 'dry-run' mode that validates manifests without changing state.
Julia (Support): Can we get a one-pager with common failure modes and recommended fixes? We'll ship that with runbooks.
deploy-bot: RFC created: https://go/repo/rfcs/private-deploy-upgrade-flow — reviewers: @miguel @anya @samir
Anya (PM): Next steps: Miguel to draft upgrade playbook + CI tests by Tue; Samir to draft rollback SLIs; Lin to schedule pilot customer calls; Julia to draft support one-pager. I'll sync with Eng leadership on timeline. :thumbsup:
Miguel (Eng): Will start PR for helm + e2e upgrade test. Tagging follow-ups in RFC.
Samir (SRE): I'll prototype the dry-run validator and share logs format.
Lin (Solutions): Scheduling pilots — prefer two mid-market and one enterprise with strict NetOps.
Anya (PM): OK — aim to close v1 scope by end of next sprint. If anyone has blockers ping me directly.
Julia (Support): Adding runbook template to the shared drive now.
Miguel (Eng): FYI — one constraint: on-prem customers with strict egress rules will need an outbound proxy. Will document pattern.
Anya (PM): Thanks all. We'll reconvene after RFC comments are addressed.
